ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the vertical axis is s(t), and the horizontal axis is t. The signal jumps from 0 to amplitude A at t=T_B/3, and remains at the constant value A until it falls back to 0 at t=T_B; therefore this input signal is a rectangular pulse, with amplitude A and time support interval [T_B/3, T_B]. Then reason: The energy of this signal is E_s=∫_{T_B/3}^{T_B} A^2 dt=A^2(T_B-T_B/3)=2A^2T_B/3. When the two-sided power spectral density of the input Gaussian white noise is n_0/2, the maximum output signal-to-noise ratio of the matched filter is r_{0max}=2E_s/n_0. Substituting the energy gives r_{0max}=2(2A^2T_B/3)/n_0=4A^2T_B/(3n_0).

method.method_draft: First describe the image and write the waveform support and amplitude. Choose the matched-filter impulse response h(t)=C s(T_B-t) or equivalently the time-reversed delayed version matched to the shown pulse. At the peak sampling time, y_s=C E_s, where E_s=∫_{T_B/3}^{T_B}A^2dt=2A^2T_B/3. The noise variance is σ_n^2=(n0/2)∫h^2(t)dt=(n0/2)C^2E_s. Therefore SNR=(C^2E_s^2)/[(n0/2)C^2E_s]=2E_s/n0=4A^2T_B/(3n0).
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中纵轴标为 s(t)，横轴标为 t。信号在 0 到 T_B/3 之间为 0；从 t=T_B/3 开始跳变到幅度 A，并一直保持矩形脉冲幅度 A 到 t=T_B；在 t=T_B 处下降为 0。因此该输入信号可写为 s(t)=A, T_B/3 \le t \le T_B，其他时间为 0。推理：对该信号的匹配滤波器可取冲激响应 h(t)=C s(T_B-t)，即与输入脉冲相匹配的延迟反褶版本。峰值采样时刻的信号输出为 y_s=C E_s，其中信号能量 E_s=\int_{T_B/3}^{T_B} A^2 dt=A^2(T_B-T_B/3)=2A^2T_B/3。输入高斯白噪声的双边功率谱密度为 n_0/2，所以匹配滤波器输出噪声方差为 \sigma_n^2=(n_0/2)\int h^2(t)dt=(n_0/2)C^2E_s。于是最大输出信噪比为 r_{0\max}=\frac{y_s^2}{\sigma_n^2}=\frac{C^2E_s^2}{(n_0/2)C^2E_s}=\frac{2E_s}{n_0}=\frac{2}{n_0}\cdot\frac{2A^2T_B}{3}=\frac{4A^2T_B}{3n_0}。
